summary: {person} checks whether a later start to same-day van service still works for an early appointment.
realLife: Milwaukee’s spring service notice moved the pilot’s morning start from seven to eight to stay within its budget while retaining its existing request cutoff.
gates: A same-day service window changes before the resident’s appointment.
weights: An appointment that cannot move increases the consequence of a lost morning hour.
inGame: needs: pilot service hours, requested pickup time and appointment time.
